days.name: Arrival in Delhi
days.desc: Round-trip flight from Goa to Delhi Private airport transfer Check-in at luxury 5★ deluxe hotel (upgraded room category) Leisure evening Overnight in Delhi (Luxury Hotel)

days.name: Delhi and Agra
days.desc: Board the train at Delhi in the morning. Upon arriival at Agra, visit the Taj Mahal. Overnight on the train at Agra. Onboard Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner.

days.name: Agra and Ranthambore
days.desc: Visit the Agra Fort. Return to the train for breakfast as it proceeds to Sawai Madhopur. Lunch will be served onboard. Enjoy Safari at the Ranthambore National Park. Dinner will be served onboard as the train proceeds to Jaipur

days.name: Jaipur
days.desc: After onboard breakfast, deboard to visit the Amber Fort. Return to the train for lunch. Enjoy dinner at an exclusive venue. Return to the train as it proceeds to Bikaner.

days.name: Bikaner
days.desc: After a leisurely breakfast and lunch onboard, proceed to visit the Junagarh Fort followed by an exclusive barbecue evening on the sand dunes. Train proceeds to Jodhpur.

days.name: Jodhpur
days.desc: Breakfast and lunch onboard. Morning at leisure. Post lunch, proceed to visit the Mehrangarh Fort and a walking tour of the Old Clock Tower Market followed by dinner at an exclusive venue. Train proceeds to Udaipur.

days.name: Udaipur
days.desc: After onboard breakfast proceed for boat ride on Lake Pichola and visit the City Palace. Lunch at an exclusive venue. Dinner will be served onboard as the train proceeds to Mumbai.

days.name: Arrival in Mumbai
days.desc: Breakfast & lunch onboard, Disembark in Mumbai Private transfer to Taj Mahal Palace Hotel Check-in Overnight at Taj Mahal Palace

metadata.title: 7N/8D Kerala Luxury Trip Package – 30% Off | Global Tourist Centre
metadata.description: Enjoy our exclusive 7N/8D Kerala luxury trip package with 30% off. Experience ultra-luxury stays, private back-water cruises, hill-station views and personalised service in God’s Own Country with Global Tourist Centre.

days.description: Arrive at Cochin Airport / Railway Station. Private transfer to your luxury hotel. Afternoon sightseeing: Fort Kochi & Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church, Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace), and Jewish Synagogue.
activities: Evening option: Kathakali Dance Show or Luxury Dinner Cruise

days.description: After breakfast, drive to Alleppey (approx. 4 hrs). Check-in to a Private Luxury Houseboat. Cruise through the backwaters, passing lagoons, coconut groves, paddy fields, and village life. Enjoy freshly prepared Kerala lunch, snacks, and dinner onboard.
Breakfast on board & checkout. Drive to Munnar (approx. 5 hrs) through scenic hills, tea estates & waterfalls. Evening free to relax at the luxury resort.
Full-day sightseeing in Munnar: Eravikulam National Park (Nilgiri Tahr), Tea Museum & Tea Plantations, Mattupetty Dam & Echo Point, Kundala Lake – boating experience.
activities: Wildlife spotting at Eravikulam National Park

days.description: Drive to Thekkady (approx. 3.5 hrs). Check-in at luxury resort amidst spice plantations. Activities: Periyar Lake Boat Cruise (spot elephants & wildlife), Spice Plantation Tour.
activities: Optional: Kalaripayattu Martial Arts / Kathakali performance

days.description: After breakfast, proceed to Poovar (approx. 6–7 hrs drive). Check-in at a luxury backwater + beach resort. Evening leisure by the estuary where river, backwaters, lake & sea meet.

days.day_title: Day 07: Poovar Leisure / Kovalam Visit (1 Night)
days.description: Morning relax at Poovar beach resort. Option: Excursion to Kovalam (just 30 mins away) for beach activities. Ayurveda Spa / Sunset Cruise in Poovar backwaters.
After breakfast, checkout. Transfer to Trivandrum Airport (nearest) or back to Kochi depending on flight.
